excerpt: On November 11 FTX filed Chapter 11. Within a day the commentary settled on its favorite conclusion: the gamblers were idiots. Millions of young people shovel their savings into tokens, options and parlays. The serious people shake their heads. Financial illiteracy, they say. Someone should teach these kids about compound interest. Financial illiteracy is the wrong diagnosis. Run the compound interest lesson on the official numbers.
title: The casino is the ladder
